lines.text: After twenty years of building the LORD's house and his palace, Solomon rebuilt the cities Pharaoh had given him.
Solomon captured Hamath-zobah, built Tadmor in the wilderness, and rebuilt Upper and Lower Beth-horon as fortified cities.
Solomon did not enslave the Israelites, who were his builders and 250 supervisors.
Solomon moved Pharaoh's daughter out of the City of David because the places the ark had entered were holy.
Solomon went to Ezion-geber and Eloth, and Hiram's sailors brought him 450 talents of gold from Ophir.
